sentiment.rationale: The document reports strong backward-looking results (comparable sales +12.7%, GAAP EPS +51.6%) but forward guidance is only modestly raised: Q4 comparable sales guidance was raised to 'high-single digit to low-double digit growth' from 'high-single digit increase.' The full-year operating income margin rate guidance is reaffirmed at '8 percent or higher.' The guidance raise is modest and not accompanied by a material upward revision to earnings or margin expectations, so the score is mildly positive but not strongly so.

summary.revenue: Total revenue of $25.7 billion grew 13.3 percent compared with last year, driven by total sales growth of 13.2 percent and a 22.3 percent increase in other revenue.
summary.eps: Third quarter GAAP EPS of $3.04 was 51.6 percent higher than last year, and Adjusted EPS of $3.03 was 8.7 percent higher than last year.
summary.guidance: For the fourth quarter 2021, the Company expects high-single digit to low-double digit growth in comparable sales, compared with the previous guidance for a high-single digit increase. The Company continues to expect its full-year operating income margin rate will be 8 percent or higher.
summary.margin: Third quarter operating income margin rate was 7.8 percent in 2021 compared with 8.5 percent in 2020. Third quarter gross margin rate was 28.0 percent, compared with 30.6 percent in 2020.

key_opportunities: Comparable sales growth driven entirely by traffic
